# directus_role (Resource)

Manages a Directus role (directus_roles).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the role.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the role.
- `icon` (String) Material icon name for the role.
- `parent` (String) UUID of the parent role, for nesting.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned role UUID.
